protocol.cache_sources: One canonical question per family represents an already-cached response. Positive cases are genuine, non-identical paraphrases.
protocol.selection: Only calibration cases select thresholds. Heldout labels, wording, and membership are frozen before any similarity scoring.
protocol.guard: Exact text membership in a listed canonical or reviewed paraphrase is necessary. The retrieved candidate must also match family ID, scope, and response_requirement. Unknown text and metadata mismatch bypass.
protocol.negative_labels: answer_mismatch marks an incompatible answer/output requirement; policy_exclusion marks a conservative scope/context/version exclusion even if some answer facts might coincide.
protocol.limitations: This finite curated engineering fixture is not an external human review, a random sample, an answer-quality evaluation, or evidence of general equivalence detection. Guarded zero false hits follow finite admission; similarity remains retrieval only.
